title: Evidence for a question, each piece with its source
description: The evidence behind a question about WoW: Forever, for an answer that cites its sources: facts players observed (public after three installs agree, with the install count), curated facts, and the 2023 Warcraft Wiki (marked: may differ in Forever). Every piece carries a claim, its source URL, licence and date. Returns evidence rather than prose. Further-reading links are search URLs on other sites; nothing is fetched from them. Reads Everloot's current authorized public corpus when connected; when it is not, the observed layer is unrecorded, not empty.

question.description: The question, with names spelled as in the game.

claim.description: One short statement. Observed facts are in Everloot's words; lore is the source's own excerpt.

kind.description: observed: players' uploads, public after three installs agree. curated: Everloot's own facts. files: the WoW: Forever game files, ids and facts only, found in game files and unconfirmed, with the build. lore: the 2023 Warcraft Wiki, which may differ in WoW: Forever.

asOf.description: When the source was read, or when the observations were current.

support.description: Observed facts: how many installs reported it.

url.description: The everloot.app page for this piece, absolute: the item or NPC page, or the indexed lore page. Absent when there is none.

evidence.description: Observed first, then curated, then lore.

furtherReading.description: Search links on other sites. Nothing was fetched.

dataAsOf.description: When the observed layer was current; null when it is not connected.
